# Kerbside: Style Guide

Version 1.0, January 2026

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Primary | Archive Undergrowth |
| Colours | 6 |
| Headings | Inter |
| Body | Inter |
| Scale | 6 steps, 12 to 49 px |

## 01 · Logo

The logo in each colourway, on the ground it is drawn for. The clear space is one cap height on every side; the cap height is the height of the first letter of the name. The smallest it goes is 96 px wide on screen and 24 mm wide in print.

| Colourway | Ground |
| --- | --- |
| Full colour | Raw Monochrome `#D9E6E1` |
| Mono dark | Raw Monochrome `#D9E6E1` |
| Mono light | Studio Monochrome `#050A09` |

The lockups, and where each is used:

| Lockup | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Horizontal | Headers, signatures, wide spaces. |
| Stacked | Squarer spaces, such as avatars. |
| Symbol | App icon, favicon and stamp. |

What you supply:

| Item | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| Logo | Horizontal, stacked and symbol, SVG |

## 02 · Colour

Each colour with the brand colour that reads best on it, and the contrast ratio between them.

| Colour | Role | Hex | RGB | Text on it | Ratio | Grade |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Raw Monochrome | Ground | `#D9E6E1` | 217 230 225 | Studio Monochrome | 15.5:1 | AAA |
| Studio Monochrome | Text | `#050A09` | 5 10 9 | Label | 19.9:1 | AAA |
| Soft Celadon | Panel | `#033C31` | 3 60 49 | Label | 12.4:1 | AAA |
| Archive Undergrowth | Action | `#0A7562` | 10 117 98 | Label | 5.6:1 | AA |
| Atelier Petrol | Highlight | `#4A9FBC` | 74 159 188 | Studio Monochrome | 6.6:1 | AA |
| Label | Label | `#FFFFFF` | 255 255 255 | Studio Monochrome | 19.9:1 | AAA |

Tones the guide uses, which are not on the colour list:

| Tone | Role | Hex |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Quiet text | Captions and labels | `#5E6664` |
| Action hover | Hover | `#0B6050` |
| Action pressed | Pressed | `#025647` |
| Hairline | Rules | `#BBC7C3` |
| Disabled fill | Disabled | `#C4D0CB` |
| Disabled text | Disabled | `#515957` |

The states of the button, each with the contrast of its label on it:

| State | Fill | Hex | Label | Ratio | Grade |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hover | Archive Undergrowth hover | `#0B6050` | Raised | 6.4:1 | AA |
| Pressed | Archive Undergrowth pressed | `#025647` | Raised | 7.4:1 | AAA |
| Disabled | Disabled fill | `#C4D0CB` | Label | 4.5:1 | AA |

> Ratios follow WCAG 2.2 1.4.3. AA needs 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text (24 px, or 19 px bold); AAA needs 7:1.

## 03 · Typography

Headings in Inter, body in Inter, values in IBM Plex Mono. Sizes in px against a 16 px root.

| Step | Face | Size | rem | Line | Weight | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | Inter | 49 px | 3.0625rem | 51 px | 800 | The largest line |
| Headline | Inter | 39 px | 2.4375rem | 43 px | 800 | A page headline |
| Title | Inter | 25 px | 1.5625rem | 30 px | 800 | A section title |
| Body | Inter | 16 px | 1rem | 24 px | 400 | Running copy |
| Label | Inter | 13 px | 0.8125rem | 17 px | 500 | Labels and small text |
| Caption | Inter | 12 px | 0.75rem | 17 px | 400 | Notes and folios |

## 04 · Contrast

3 pairs carry text in the brand.

| Pair | Ratio | Grade | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Studio Monochrome on Raw Monochrome | 15.5:1 | AAA | Body text and headlines |
| Raw Monochrome on Studio Monochrome | 15.5:1 | AAA | Reversed text |
| Studio Monochrome on Atelier Petrol | 6.6:1 | AA | Text on the accent |

## 05 · Tokens

| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4 px |
| `space-2` | 8 px |
| `space-3` | 12 px |
| `space-4` | 16 px |
| `space-5` | 24 px |
| `space-6` | 32 px |
| `space-7` | 48 px |
| `space-8` | 64 px |
| `space-9` | 96 px |
| `radius-control` | 6 px |
| `radius-card` | 16 px |
| `border-hairline`, `border-control` | 1 px |
| Focus ring | Studio Monochrome `#050A09` at `border-control` 1 px |

## 06 · Usage

A button, a card and a link, built from the tokens above.

| Part | Built from |
| --- | --- |
| Button | Archive Undergrowth fill, #E3F0EB label, `radius-control` 6 px, Label 13/17 px at 500, `space-3` over and `space-5` across |
| Card | Soft Celadon fill, `radius-card` 16 px, `border-control` 1 px Studio Monochrome edge, padding `space-5`, Title 25/30 px for the title and Body 16/24 px for the text |
| Link | Body 16/24 px at 400, Studio Monochrome, underlined at `border-control` 1 px |
